stylize.note: Official Midjourney docs: 'The default value for stylize is 100, and you can adjust it anywhere between 0 and 1000 with the latest Midjourney versions.' Uses --stylize / --s.

chaos.note: Official Midjourney docs: 'By default chaos is set to 0... You can set the chaos value anywhere between 0 and 100'. Uses --chaos / --c (called 'Variety' on midjourney.com).

guidance.note: Official BFL API (FLUX.1 [dev] endpoint /v1/flux-dev, FluxDevInputs schema) clamps guidance_scale to minimum 1.5, maximum 5.0, default 3.0 ('High guidance scales improve prompt adherence at the cost of reduced realism'). The project's prior set [2,3.5,5,7] includes 7, which EXCEEDS the official API max of 5.0 and should be dropped. Open-weight FLUX.1 [dev] (HuggingFace diffusers) example code uses guidance_scale=3.5; in practice the open-weight build accepts higher values (controlnet/experimental use up to 30), but for base text-to-image the sane range is ~2-5. The previously assumed 0-10 range is wider than the official API allows.

seedance.note: Official BytePlus/Volcengine 'Create a video generation task' API doc (ModelArk, Seedance family). The ratio set (16:9, 4:3, 1:1, 3:4, 9:16, 21:9, and 'adaptive') is stated verbatim in the docs. The duration parameter is 'Generated video duration in seconds' (specify either duration or frames; frames takes precedence). Exact allowed values (5 or 10 seconds) are enumerated by ByteDance Seedance API wrappers (apiframe.ai, kie.ai) and match the Seedance 1.0 paper's 5-second generation example. The project's prior [4s,8s,12s] set is NOT supported by Seedance. 'adaptive' auto-selects ratio from task type/input.
seedance.unverifiedReason: The official BytePlus page confirms duration is in seconds and lists the full ratio set, but does not explicitly enumerate the allowed numeric duration values inline in the fetched content; the 5s/10s enumeration is corroborated by multiple ByteDance Seedance API-wrapper docs (apiframe.ai/docs/videos/seedance/seedance-1-pro, kie.ai/bytedance/seedance-v1) rather than the top-level official page.

runway.note: Official Runway help center, 'Creating with Gen-4 Video': 'Gen-4 currently offers outputs in 5 and 10 second durations.' Resolutions/aspect ratios: Horizontal 16:9 (1280x720), Vertical 9:16 (720x1280), Square 1:1 (960x960). Gen-4 Turbo uses the same 5s/10s durations. (Newer Gen-4.5 / third-party docs reference 5/8/10s and additional ratios like 4:3/3:4/21:9, but the official Runway Gen-4 doc confirms 5s/10s and 16:9/9:16/1:1.)

kling.note: Official Kling AI user guide (Kling Video 2.6 Audio User Guide): 'Video Duration: 5s, 10s' and 'Aspect Ratio: 16:9, 1:1, 9:16'. Corroborated by Kling-Text2Video-V2.1-Master API docs (GMI Cloud): duration options '5'/'10', aspect_ratio options '16:9'/'9:16'/'1:1', default 16:9. The project's prior assumption of 10s max is correct; Kling V3 (via some API partners) extends up to 15s but the official Kling consumer guide lists 5s/10s.
